column1: Verified every major displayed market value has a defensible timestamp from the data source, not browser page-load time.
- Data state: CURRENT_5M (when market open), LAST_VALID (when market closed)
- Label: CURRENT or LAST VALID per freshness ✅
No section uses `new Date()` or `Date.now()` as the displayed market-data timestamp. All timestamps come from server/database data.

index.html inline script 3 uses `new Date()` for the SESSION STATE indicator (PRE_MARKET/OPEN/CLOSED). This is correct — it shows MARKET TIME, not data freshness. The session state indicator is separate from data timestamps.
All major displayed values have defensible timestamps from data sources. No timestamps are fabricated from browser time. ✅
